# AGV IT Consulting

> Affordable websites, webshops and booking systems for small businesses, freelancers and local shops — built fast with AI (such as Claude) and finished, tested and hosted by hand by Arnold Verhoeven, an IT consultant and web developer based in Antwerp, Belgium. A simple professional website costs a few hundred euros instead of a few thousand. Also: IT consultancy and IT project management (ISO 27001, NIS2, IAM/SSO, infrastructure).

Key facts:
- Business: AGV IT Consulting BV, Antwerpen, Belgium. Works across Flanders and online.
- Contact: arnold.verhoeven@agv-it.be · +32 499 46 44 20
- Languages: Dutch, English, French
- Pricing: websites from a few hundred euros; clear quote up front; no page-builder subscription
- Approach: a working mock-up of the client's own site first, then adjust together, then live on the client's own domain with hosting, SSL, basic SEO and social previews
- Webshops via Shopzo.be (own multi-tenant e-commerce platform for small retailers)
- Background: 13+ years of IT project management (pharma, logistics, healthcare, rail); PMP and PRINCE2 certified
